notes.title: 'Stop the tyrannical overlord' 8.0 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Brownie's Adventure 8.0[/h1][h3]*Old version still accessible via 'beta' branch for people in mid play through
[/h3][p]Thanks to feedback from brave and intrepid explorers across the globe I can bring you the '8.0' update.    I even removed the 'go faster stripes' from the edge of a couple of screens.   Ray tracing is now disabled by default. [/p][list][*][p]Escape now accesses save/options[/p][/*][*][p]F1 switches windowed/full screen[/p][/*][*][p]fixed glitch with Steve the frog[/p][/*][*][p]Ants no longer use AGS plugin for movement and have drawn animation sequences with[/p][p]less irritating movement patterns.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unwanted dialogue on WPC barmaid before key event[/p][/*][*][p]Added randomised footstep sounds to Brownie[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue GUI now doesn't occupy the BG image as much and utilizies space better[/p][/*][*][p]Added UI sounds for gaining items[/p][/*][*][p]Added new title screen BG[/p][/*][*][p]Added UI clicks[/p][/*][*][p]Added new inventory item sprites with better clickability[/p][/*][*][p]Closed down potential bug in end conflict[/p][/*][*][p]Added some missing respones on inventory uses/hotspots[/p][/*][*][p]Touched up and fixed Grundolph's shop BG[/p][/*][*][p]Touched up and fixed Grottenberg City Entrance BG[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Swamp BG[/p][/*][*][p]A few text colours changed for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Firanygre's idle animation on court scene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a puzzle to be more cohesive in Act 3[/p][/*][*][p]Created new Intro/help Information and assets[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of small things... almost a Blink 182 song[/p][/*][/list]

7.23 update - Minor bugs (and one very odd one)

- Revisiting tome no longer possible after Act 3 has begun 
- Dialogue no longer triggers when it shouldn't in the alleyway in Grottenburg 
- Stopped a disappearing dialogue with 'Tabs' the barmaid to help players remember what to do
- Altered political speech now has interactions
- Added 'safeguards' for the multiple variations of the fight scene to fix possible crash (rare)

notes.content:

- Fixed 'use on' pegs interactions

- Slightly increased size of hotspots for kebabylon 5 missing delivery puzzle
- Gui hidden in Act 3 final bomb scene
- Added crossfade for audio tracks
- Interactions for discarded disguise
- Enlarged hotspot for jungle trail
- Fixed lots of little things (please let me know via discord if you discover a bug!)[/i]

notes.title: 7.0 - Give us a clue pal
notes.content:
[h2][b]7.0 Update [/b][/h2]

- Sped up/changed walking animation
- Allowed left click/right click to skip dialogue
- Temu Jedi clue guy repeats the clue as many times as needed
- Fixed issue with lack of clues in Act 2 for main quest
- Objects moved/general tidying/typos
- Crab no longer vanishes magically if you attempt to release
- Fixed some inventory item interactions

notes.title: 6.51 - minor bugfix
notes.content:
6.51 - minor bug fix

- Some players had items on start they shouldn't

A few bug fixes 

- Fixed the animagic/mouse interaction soft locking player on the tome chest
- Added clue to existence of secret trail into jungle at the 'big tree'
- Added a few interactions that were missing for items

Have tested as much as possible to preserve saves. Should be fine.

notes.content:
Update Alpha 5.95 

- No longer plays the whole of  'Winter Solstice' when leaving drunk room
- Witch's dialogue line now spoken by her instead of player in Act 1
